notes.title: # Patch Notes: Version 5.7.3
notes.content:
## Character Updates

- **Shiro**
  - **Sweep Move**
    - Adjusted hit velocity for improved performance and gameplay consistency.
  - **Air High Kick Move**
    - Increased freeze hit stun and added screen shake upon hitting opponents, adding weight and impact to the move.
  - **Air Recovery**
    - Updated sound effect for air recovery to enhance clarity and responsiveness.
  - **Element Control**
    - Updated VFX to reflect Shiro's control over the wind element.
    - Updated move set accordingly.

- **Spiral**
  - Revamped spear VFX and added a rotation animation.
  - **Spear Move**
    - Fixed issue where, when the spear hits an opponent at full screen, the opponent now goes into a dizzy state instead of being frozen in the spear hit animation.
    - Added wind VFX to enhance visual impact.
  - **Teleport Ability**
    - Added new effect and revamped sounds.
    - Increased screen shake and freeze hit stun.

- **Glacius**
  - Updated move set to control water elements.
  - More moves to come in future updates.

- **Kahn Tara**
  - Changed VFX effects from green to yellow for enhanced visual consistency.

- **Bolo**
  - Disabled for this update as the character is being revamped.

## General Improvements

- Updated to a more stable version of the core engine being used.
- Fixed a memory leak that was causing the game to slow down and crash.

## Visual Effects (VFX) & Animation

- Optimized and updated VFX:
  - Enhanced dust animations.
  - Revamped and optimized hit effects and dust animations.
  - Added dust animations to character takeoff animations.
  - Revamped hit effects and optimized performance.
  - Updated rough get-up animations, resulting in smoother transitions for all characters.

## Gameplay Enhancements

- Added shadows to characters:
  - Shadows dynamically adjust between normal and circular shapes based on character states (grounded or airborne).
  - Shadows fade in and out based on character height for visual clarity.

## Other Improvements

- Updated stage select screen:
  - Added stage portraits to assist players in selecting stages visually.
  - Three stages have been removed and will be updated tomorrow to better fit the game's style.
- Character select screen revamped to fit the game's lore.

## Known Issues

- Movelist shows moves crossed out, indicating these moves are currently works in progress (WIP).
- Supers and finishers are being worked on.

## Removed Content

- Intro screen has been removed and is currently being revamped.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Version 5.7.1
notes.content:
## Visual Effects
- **Character "Claw"**
  - Fixed GroundHit effect during the move "Quake Crusher".
  - Resolved an issue where a destroyed game object was still being accessed, causing the game to freeze.
  - This fix addresses the potential cause of the KO screen freezing.

## Animations
- **Character "Shiro"**
  - Fixed airHit animation. When hit by Bolo's move "Hell Fire," Shiro will no longer fall through the fireball.
- **All Characters**
  - Fixed getThrown animation to ensure characters are in full stun while being thrown.

## User Interface
- Fixed scrolling issues in the AfterBattleScreen menu.
- Corrected the title naming on the NetworkRandomMatchScreen.
- Resized and restructured UI elements on the NetworkJoinGameScreen.
- Resized and restructured UI elements on the NetworkHostGameScreen.

## HitBox
- **Character "Bolo"**
  - Fixed missing frames for the dizzy animation.

## Character "Glacia"
- Fixed missing "Move Info" reaction for Spiral's move "Spear".

## New Features
- **Resolution Settings**
  - Added screen resolution settings. Ensure your monitor matches the selected resolution to avoid gameplay issues such as characters moving off-camera. For 16:9 monitors, use a compatible resolution.

- **Full Screen Toggle**
  - Added the option to switch between fullscreen and windowed mode. Apply changes by pressing the apply button.

tags.bug: - Fixed GroundHit effect during the move "Quake Crusher".
- Resolved an issue where a destroyed game object was still being accessed, causing the game to freeze.
- This fix addresses the potential cause of the KO screen freezing.
- Fixed airHit animation. When hit by Bolo's move "Hell Fire," Shiro will no longer fall through the fireball.
- Fixed getThrown animation to ensure characters are in full stun while being thrown.
- Fixed scrolling issues in the AfterBattleScreen menu.
- Corrected the title naming on the NetworkRandomMatchScreen.
- Fixed missing frames for the dizzy animation.
- Fixed missing "Move Info" reaction for Spiral's move "Spear".
